evidence.note: A benchmark-construction framework that extracts the reasoning graph behind each item in an existing benchmark and perturbs it to generate new test items at controlled complexity levels, then measures how 15 LLMs degrade as complexity rises.
evidence.title: DARG: Dynamic Evaluation of Large Language Models via Adaptive Reasoning Graph

name: existing reasoning benchmarks across four domains, extended by DARG (individual benchmark names not given in the supplied material)
